$comment: The skills the harness offers. `common` fits every framework; `frameworks` lists the ones only some frameworks get. A skill with `install` comes from its own repo: apply.mjs runs that command in the project when the skill is missing (later, `npx skills update` updates it). One without `install` is the harness's own, copied whole from library/.claude/skills. A skill with `needs` is offered only with that module.

improve-harness.describe: end of a feature, or when a hook, rule or skill misbehaved: find harness problems and fix the approved ones.

playwright-cli.describe: drive the browser, check a feature, write end-to-end tests.
playwright-cli.install: npx -y skills add microsoft/playwright-cli --skill playwright-cli -a claude-code --copy -y

context7-mcp.describe: library docs and code examples through Context7.
context7-mcp.install: npx -y skills add upstash/context7 --skill context7-mcp -a claude-code --copy -y

web-design-guidelines.describe: review UI against the Web Interface Guidelines.
web-design-guidelines.install: npx -y skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill web-design-guidelines -a claude-code --copy -y

vercel-react-best-practices.install: npx -y skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill vercel-react-best-practices -a claude-code --copy -y

vercel-composition-patterns.install: npx -y skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill vercel-composition-patterns -a claude-code --copy -y
